title: Token scaling and touch affordance audit for mobile Safari & Firefox
creator: Asha Patel
description: Audit and triage of token-driven component regressions affecting touch interactions and visual scaling on mobile browsers (Safari iOS and Firefox Android). Recent runtime updates to spacing tokens and adaptive type scaling introduced inconsistent hit areas and chart pinch/zoom issues on narrow viewports. Goal: identify root causes, categorize fixes (design token change vs component guardrail), and ship a prioritized buglist + small fixes for the next UI kit patch.
scope: Buttons and floating actions: touch target shrinkage when tokens collapse at <360px
Tables: horizontal scroll snap + row density changes on iOS Safari with momentum scrolling
Charts: pinch-to-zoom gesture jitter on Firefox Android and missing top padding when axis labels wrap
Token scale: small/compact token tokenization math regressions in responsive breakpoints
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Using iPhone 12 / iOS 16 Safari, open dashboard A (Figma prototype link) and reduce viewport width to 320px; observe primary button hit area vs visual size
2) On Android Pixel 5 Firefox, open charts page and attempt pinch-to-zoom; note jitter and occasional double-zoom events
3) In mobile Safari, navigate to table with dense rows and perform horizontal swipe; observe content jump when momentum scroll bounces
4) Toggle reduced-motion and large-text; ensure tokens don't overlap or hide affordances
acceptance_criteria: Repro cases documented with device/browser pairs and screenshots or screen recordings
Categorized buglist with owner (Design/ENG) and proposed remediation: token update, component clamp, or runtime workaround
At least two small fixes merged and released to ui-kit-2026.03 that address the highest-impact regressions (button hit area + chart zoom jitter)
Regression tests added to cross-browser QA checklist (manual steps + e2e script pointers)
decisions: Prefer component-level guardrails (min-tap-size, clamp on font-size) where token changes cause widespread layout shifts
Avoid broad token scale changes for now — isolate fixes to compact breakpoint overrides until runtime batching is validated
Chart jitter will be mitigated through input event debounce in the chart component rather than changing gesture handling at the runtime layer
risks: Token changes are high-risk and may cascade to multiple components if applied globally
Minor visual differences across browsers may persist due to platform gestures (momentum/bounce) that are not fully controllable from the UI kit
Time-boxed fixes may leave lower-priority issues for a later cycle
next_steps: Create reproduction bundles (HTML sandbox) for each atomic issue and link to ticket comments
Pair with ENG runtime team to validate whether token compression is applied during build optimizations (sync meeting scheduled)
Implement component clamp for buttons and add visual regression snapshots for small viewports
Open PR for chart input debounce and include device lab recordings in the PR description
